title: SMOK IPX80 Pod Vape Kit
description: The new IPX80 Pod Kit from Smok is an incredible pod kit designed to withstand the toughest treatment while still delivering the rich flavour, versatility and performance you’ve come to expect from Smok vapes. Certified IPX67 waterproof, dustproof and shockproof, the IPX80 is as rugged and tough as pod kits gets, making it ideal for vapers who lead an active, outdoors lifestyle. And with a mighty 3000mAh internal battery, the IPX80 will easily last throughout an entire day of adventure. And with super-quick charging, the IPX80 will be ready to go when you are. The SMOK IPX has features a unique adjustable airflow wheel that is controlled via the air inlet ring on each side above the device. This lets you literally dial in to your preferred style of vape and is one of the best airflow controls we’ve seen on similar devices. Furthermore, the IPX80 has been built to cater for both DL (direct-to-lung) and MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping styles. That’s thanks to the device’s 1-80W power output range, and is supported by a host of built-in safety features. The IPX80 comes with an RPM2 pod and two RPM 2 coils . Compatible with Smok’s entire range of RPM and RPM2 coils, the IPX80 comes with a 0.16ohm RPM2 Mesh Coil and a 0.6ohm RPM2 MTL Coil straight out of the box. We recommend the 0.16ohm RPM2 Mesh Coil for a sublime sub-ohm DL experience with High VG e-liquids, and the 0.6ohm coil for a tighter, satisfying MTL experience ideal for Classic/High PG, 50/50 and Nicotine Salts e-liquids. The RPM2 Pod features a super-comfortable duck-bill mouthpiece and lets you clearly see your e-liquid levels so you can ensure your tank doesn’t run dry. When you need to refill your pod with e-liquid, the side fill port makes refilling clean, quick and convenient. With its sturdy, resilient build, compact, ergonomic design and the sheer quality of the vaping experience, the IPX80 is a superb pod mod device suitable for all vapers, especially those seeking a tough and reliable vape kit for all environments and situations. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
